content.text:
For a review target containing "compression", follow this section instead of
all legacy first-contrast instructions below. The user approved decision 0019
on 2026-09-23: compare linear/relative successful-response costs, then test
compression of the competent E1 model. No gradient-history additions.

Read AGENTS.md, LAB_NOTES operations, docs/decisions/0019-successful-response-compression.md,
and docs/plans/read-table-compression.md. Follow the declared horizon, fresh
100-instance development allocation, matched task-only continuation, and selected
relative cost at weight 0.1. Selection was by offline engineering criteria,
not a learned-performance comparison. Preserve all historical results.

Order: readiness-compression-relative-s4015 -> table-compression-start-s4009 ->
table-compression-control-s4009 -> table-compression-relative-s4009 -> final review.
The first stage is 3 full-geometry updates plus 10 eval episodes. Start evaluates
the original E1 update-300 adapter on the new development questions. The last two
stages each initialize those same adapter tensors with fresh matched optimizers,
train 90 additional updates, and evaluate all thirds (30/60/90). Primary is 90.
No extra weights, seeds, models, family or horizon extension is admitted.

1. Read canonical remote state and actual processes first. Never duplicate work.
2. Harvest without adapters, explicitly including checkpoint_origin.json and
   checkpoint-evals/. Verify hashes locally/remotely. Check config, admission,
   source, stack and the initial adapter provenance. Run from the Mac root:
   .venv-test/bin/python pipeline/runs/table-compression-s4009-ops/review_run.py <run>.
   This checks visible-table correctness, metrics and basic training provenance;
   it does not replace your review. Copy technical_review.json to the box.
3. For readiness, additionally inspect all first-batch captures, actual rewards,
   mean-only advantages, assistant/tool masks, DAPO denominator, selected-token
   sampler/trainer log probabilities, finite gradients and changed LoRA tensors.
   Reuse probes.readiness_replay._trainer/_loss_check on the saved loss shards
   under CPU with CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty. The old full readiness assessor
   deliberately does not admit this new reward; do not modify it or label it E1.
   Recompute the new cost with independent reference_costs in compare_length_costs.
   Verify initial_adapter.json confirms byte-identical trainable initialization,
   installed adapter-load tests pass, policy reload/eval succeeds, and initial
   vLLM rollouts/logprobs reflect the trained adapter. No unexplained mismatch
   admits a longer run. Keep readiness under the existing two GPU-hour ceiling.
4. For continuation training, audit group_observations and all 90 finite log rows,
   costs/active groups and preserved initializer hashes. Zero task-only gradients
   on uniform-success batches are expected, not an automatic failure. Inspect
   errors, stop outcomes and planned checkpoints. No silent reruns or repairs to
   experiment measurements.
5. Write a source/input-bound review.json locally and remotely, including all
   technical evidence and initial-adapter/capture/provenance files where present.
   On technical pass for readiness/start/control immediately run the next phase
   via runs/table-compression-s4009-ops/launch.py --phase start/control/relative
   --check-only under CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 and the canonical venv in pipeline/.
   Then launch without --check-only, using subprocess.Popen(start_new_session=True),
   DEVNULL stdin and a fresh controller log. Verify actual child PID/command/state.
   This launch is already authorized; merely proposing it is incomplete.
6. On final relative completion run the new ops/analyze.py from repository root.
   Report all three paired contrasts (treatment/control, treatment/start,
   control/start), primary step 90, success preservation, 10% compression target,
   off-target and budget panels, qualitative trajectories, and costs. Reuse
   eval.paired for absolute differences and stop transitions. Persist findings to
   pipeline/runs/table_compression_s4009_findings.md. This is development evidence;
   there is no admitted further model phase regardless of outcome. Set canonical
   state to reviewed; decision required and wait for the user's review.

Reconcile taskwarrior rc.context=thesis, current RUNNING with box UTC, and the
existing completion receipt/claim. Do not commit/push, spawn agents, edit the
watcher or old claims, or change this protocol. A failed technical invariant or
new scientific decision stops advancement with evidence, not fabricated success.

--- Legacy instructions for non-compression targets only ---

Continue the user's authorized read-table-2 first contrast in the main master
checkout. This separate review is the explicitly requested unattended harvest,
review and advancement. Do not resume the desktop thread, commit/push, branch,
spawn agents, edit thesis.pdf, or revert existing work.

Read AGENTS.md, RUNNING.md, LAB_NOTES operations, decision 0018, and
docs/plans/read-table-first-contrast.md. The user approved on 2026-09-21:
continue read-table-2 until the first informative result, then consider other
families/environments. Success saturation is allowed. E3 is secondary. Do not
reinstate the old 90% ceiling or start other families, weights or environments.

The frozen order is table-first-e0-s4009 -> table-first-e1-s4009 ->
table-first-e2-l040-s4009 -> reviewed first result. Source, stack, recipe,
weight 0.4, 200 held-out questions at seeds 4009100000-4009100199, and all
analysis rules are fixed in the plan and runs/table-first-s4009-ops/admission.json.
Every stage uses held_out_table. E0 is base evaluation; E1 evaluates byte-identical
copies of the existing pilot adapters with explicit checkpoint_origin.json;
E2 trains from the same original base for 300 updates. E1 and E2 retain all
100/200/300 observations. The primary endpoint is 300, never the best checkpoint.

1. Read live remote state, actual worker and exits before acting. Canonical state
   is /workspace/master-thesis-code/pipeline/runs/table-diagnostic-s4008-ops/state.json.
   Never duplicate a live process. Use physical GPU 1 and the canonical box venv.
2. Harvest this run without checkpoint adapters. Explicitly include
   checkpoint_origin.json and separately harvest checkpoint-evals/ (the broad
   checkpoint* exclusion otherwise hides it). Verify all remote/local file
   hashes. Bind config, reference, admission, source/stack, successful exits,
   checkpoint paths/steps and reports. Reuse the plan's existing checkpoint
   evidence and the original pilot's review; do not retrain E1.
3. From the Mac repository root run .venv-test/bin/python
   pipeline/runs/table-first-s4009-ops/review_run.py <run>. It reuses the reviewed
   visible-table audit, checks every evaluation trajectory and recomputes metrics.
   Inspect its output, provenance and logs. Copy technical_review.json back to
   the canonical remote run. This arithmetic check does not replace your review.
   For E2 additionally inspect all 300 finite updates, the 13 observed batches,
   raw rewards/advantages and source-bound readiness; inspect all success
   regressions and the declared masked trajectory sample. Use the original pilot
   review_pilot.py and existing eval.paired helpers without altering old evidence.
4. Write a reviewed, source-bound review.json locally and remotely with
   reviewed_run, verdict, next_action, reason, input_sha256. Bind the canonical
   inputs required by the contract, technical_review.json, and for E1/E2 every
   scheduled intermediate report, episodes and env_stamp. Record findings in
   pipeline/runs/table_first_s4009_findings.md. For E0/E1, the gate is technical
   validity, never a demanded accuracy or budget rate.
   For E1 also bind checkpoint_origin.json and adapter_config.json plus
   adapter_model.safetensors in checkpoint-100, checkpoint-200 and checkpoint-final.
   Hash those files on the GPU box; do not download adapters. Verify every copy
   against admission.json's original checkpoint hashes before admitting E2.
5. On E0 or E1 technical pass, immediately execute the admitted next stage:
   from remote pipeline/, run CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 PYTHONPATH=.
   /workspace/master-thesis-code/.venv/bin/python
   runs/table-first-s4009-ops/launch.py --phase e1 (or e2) --check-only.
   If it passes, launch the same command without --check-only via subprocess.Popen
   with start_new_session=True, stdin DEVNULL and a fresh controller log in that
   ops directory. Preserve the canonical env variables. Verify its actual child
   process and live state. Save the controller PID and command. A passing review
   with the next run only proposed is incomplete delivery. The launcher owns
   train-to-eval progression; the installed watcher owns completion review.
6. On E2 completion, compute the declared paired endpoint analysis using
   runs/table-first-s4009-ops/analyze.py. Report success preservation, token target,
   grounded off-target outcomes, training liveness and costs, and all limitations.
   A null, adverse or inconclusive research effect is a legitimate result; no
   additional weight or sample extension is admitted. Mark this tranche reviewed
   and awaiting the user's result review. Preserve all successful technical
   results even if the desired efficiency effect is absent.

Keep RUNNING limited to actual live/unharvested phases, stamped with box UTC;
remove harvested prior rows before the next stage and mirror the remote file.
Read and reconcile taskwarrior with rc.context=thesis. Run ./.claude/check.sh
after changes. A launched run is not a done task.

If the original pilot appears in watched state, its historical review is already
complete and the user has now approved decision 0018; do not modify its claim or
re-run its review. The new first stage has a separate admission.

The completion contract below is mandatory. Do not change the watcher, contract,
old claims or declared analysis during review. On a technical failure, preserve
evidence and report the concrete blocker. No fabricated pass or technical blocker.

Review target: readiness-compression-relative-s4015.
Previous delivery error: none
Copy the exact review JSON to /Users/mheidebrecht/Library/Application Support/ThesisReview/claims/readiness-compression-relative-s4015/attempt-1/review.json before returning.
A successful process exit is not completion. Follow the completion contract below.
For the four decision-0019 compression targets, this sequence supersedes the
legacy first-contrast sequence below:
readiness-compression-relative-s4015 pass -> table-compression-start-s4009 pass ->
table-compression-control-s4009 pass -> table-compression-relative-s4009 final.
Every target binds episodes_development_table.jsonl and technical_review.json.
Also bind all training, adapter-initialization, readiness and scheduled-eval
provenance applicable to that stage. Only the final relative stage has no next
run. The original receipt schema, hash checks, live-child checks and canonical
remote-state rules below remain mandatory. Technical failures may stop.

Completion requires verified advancement or the recorded final result/blocker.

Save review.json under pipeline/runs/<reviewed_run>/ with fields:
reviewed_run, verdict (pass/fail/inconclusive/technical_blocker), next_action
(continued/decision_required), reason, input_sha256. Input keys are repository
relative pipeline/runs/... paths, never runs/...; bind actual remote SHA256s.
For completed first-contrast stages include config.yaml, env_stamp.json,
eval_report.json, episodes_held_out_table.jsonl, phase_exit.json and
technical_review.json. For trained/scheduled stages also bind train evidence
where applicable, checkpoint provenance, intermediate reports, episodes and
env_stamp files. Earlier diagnostic IDs use episodes_development_table.jsonl.
E1 must also bind checkpoint_origin.json and both adapter_config.json and
adapter_model.safetensors in each copied checkpoint directory. Obtain their
hashes remotely and verify them against the admitted original pilot artifacts.
Copy this exact review.json to the attempt path supplied in this invocation.

E0 pass requires launching table-first-e1-s4009. E1 pass requires launching
table-first-e2-l040-s4009. E2 completion requires delivery of the reviewed result;
there is no admitted successor in this tranche. Scientific null, adverse or
inconclusive effects do not trigger more runs. Technical failures may stop.

All launches update the same remote state at
/workspace/master-thesis-code/pipeline/runs/table-diagnostic-s4008-ops/state.json.
For continuation it must identify the admitted next run, phase train/eval, and
an actual live child PID whose command contains that run ID; a successful
already-completed next phase also qualifies. For a final result or legitimate
failure record phase="reviewed; decision required", run=<reviewed_run>, pid=null,
and updated=<box UTC>. Remove harvested rows from RUNNING.md. The state phrase
also covers awaiting the user's review of the completed first result.

Return exactly the output-schema JSON fields: reviewed_run, outcome
(continued/decision_required), next_run (launched ID or null), review_path,
review_sha256, summary. The watcher independently validates hashes and actual
continuation. A zero CLI exit or a future-tense next step does not complete it.
It retries incomplete delivery once and then records a blocker.
